title: Conditions and adab of the murid
summary: Who can give bai'at, how to choose a murshid, how to sit in his company, what to do after a slip, and how Hazrat speaks of khilafat.

blocks.p: Hazrat reads that some say the murid should be an adult, and some that he should have understanding and insight: able to tell good from bad. Sometimes bai'at is taken even from small children for blessing; this is called bai'at-e-barakat. For women, bai'at by word of mouth is enough, and Hazrat reads that a woman does not need to unveil before the shaykh, however old he may be.

blocks.h: Look first, then give your hand

blocks.p: Hazrat reads that the shaykh should be able to fulfil the aim of discipleship, should know the verses of the Qur'an's commands and the necessary matters of hadith and fiqh, and should have been blessed by the company of an experienced personality. Permission to give khilafat, he says, comes from above, through the chain of murshids.

blocks.q: Some elders have given this mark of a good murshid: in whose company all whisperings and idle thoughts stop, and a person's mind becomes bound to Allah and His Messenger ﷺ. Look first and understand, then give your hand. Otherwise regret follows.
When I speak, keep looking into my eyes. The states that come out of my eyes come into your eyes too. That is why you should keep your eyes open and keep looking at the murshid.

blocks.p: The Companions used to keep looking at the Prophet ﷺ, Hazrat says, and they also lowered their gaze out of respect.

blocks.q: If someone makes a mistake after giving bai'at, he should repent and say: Astaghfirullah al-'Azeem alladhi la ilaha illa Huwa al-Hayy al-Qayyum wa atubu ilayh. Repentance never goes to waste.

blocks.p: Hazrat also tells of a Companion whom the Prophet ﷺ told to give bai'at again, though he had already given it. 'Once you have given bai'at, renew it,' Hazrat says. 'That is what I do.'

Khilafat, Hazrat says, comes from above. A murid may wonder whether he is worthy, but he should not ask; he should stay silent. Khilafat is the confirmation that a murid has become worthy, like a certificate given after study.

blocks.q: Neither a merely formal discipleship is of any use, nor a merely formal khilafat.
That is why I keep saying: read this book. It teaches not only the murid, but the shaykh too.

blocks.note: Hazrat also says he makes no one a murid without permission from Sarkar, and sometimes sends a person back (Nizam-ul-Amal part 3, 27:44). The recording does not make clear whether Sarkar here means the Prophet ﷺ or his shaykh: ask your teacher.

ru.title: Murid ki sharait aur aadaab
ru.summary: Bai'at kaun de sakta hai, murshid ko kaise chunein, unki sohbat mein kaise baithein, ghalti ho jaaye to kya karein, aur Hazrat khilafat ke baare mein kya farmate hain.

blocks.p: Hazrat padhte hain ke kuch log kehte hain murid baaligh ho, aur kuch kehte hain ke usko samajh aur baseerat ho: achhe aur bure mein farq kar sake. Kabhi kabhi chhote bachchon se bhi barakat ke liye bai'at le li jaati hai; isko bai'at-e-barakat kehte hain. Auraton ke liye zabaani bai'at kaafi hai, aur Hazrat padhte hain ke aurat ko shaykh ke saamne parda hataane ki zaroorat nahin, chaahe shaykh kitne bhi umr-raseeda kyun na hon.

Hazrat padhte hain ke shaykh mein mureedi ka maqsad poora karne ki qaabiliyat ho, woh Qur'an ke ahkaam ki aayaton aur hadith o fiqh ke zaroori masaail se waaqif ho, aur kisi tajurbekaar hasti ki sohbat ka faiz paaya ho. Khilafat dene ki ijaazat, woh farmate hain, upar se aati hai, murshidon ke silsile ke zariye.

blocks.q: Ba'z buzurgon ne achhe murshid ki yeh tameez batayi hai ke jis ki sohbat mein waswase aur fuzool khayalaat sab band ho jaayein, aur aadmi ka khayal Khuda aur Rasool ﷺ ke saath waabasta ho jaaye. Pehle dekho aur samjho, phir haath do. Warna pachtaawa hota hai.
Jab main baat karun to meri aankhon mein dekhte raho. Meri aankhon se jo kaifiyaat nikalti hain, woh tumhari aankhon mein bhi aati hain. Isi liye aankhein khuli rakho aur murshid ko dekhte raho.

blocks.p: Sahaba Huzoor ﷺ ko dekhte rehte the, Hazrat farmate hain, aur adab ki wajah se nazar bhi neechi rakhte the.

blocks.q: Agar koi bai'at ke baad ghalti kare to tauba kare aur kahe: Astaghfirullah al-'Azeem alladhi la ilaha illa Huwa al-Hayy al-Qayyum wa atubu ilayh. Tauba kabhi zaaya nahin jaati.

blocks.p: Hazrat ek Sahabi ka waaqia bhi sunaate hain jinko Huzoor ﷺ ne dobara bai'at karne ka farmaya, haalaanke woh pehle bai'at kar chuke the. 'Ek baar bai'at kar li to uski tajdeed karo,' Hazrat farmate hain. 'Main bhi yahi karta hoon.'

Khilafat, Hazrat farmate hain, upar se aati hai. Murid ke dil mein khayal aa sakta hai ke kya main iske laayeq hoon, lekin woh maange nahin; khaamosh rahe. Khilafat is baat ki tasdeeq hai ke murid laayeq ho gaya hai, jaise padhai ke baad certificate diya jaata hai.

blocks.q: Na sirf rasmi mureedi kisi kaam ki hai, na sirf rasmi khilafat.
Isi liye main baar baar kehta hoon: yeh kitaab padho. Yeh sirf murid ko nahin, shaykh ko bhi sikhaati hai.

blocks.note: Hazrat yeh bhi farmate hain ke woh Sarkar ki ijaazat ke baghair kisi ko murid nahin karte, aur kabhi kabhi kisi ko waapas bhej dete hain (Nizam-ul-Amal part 3, 27:44). Recording se yeh saaf nahin hota ke yahaan Sarkar se muraad Huzoor ﷺ hain ya unke shaykh: apne ustaad se poochiye.
